use_cases.name: Complete a self-service action in three taps
use_cases.goal: Let an employee punch, view a payslip, apply for leave or a gate pass, or raise a ticket in three taps or fewer, with attendance and payslip available offline.

stakeholders.interest: Fewer walk-in queries about attendance and pay.
Requests arrive complete and in one queue.

use_cases.trigger: The employee opens the app with an intent (punch, payslip, leave, gate pass, ticket).
preconditions: The employee has an active assignment and an enrolled device.
Self-service actions are enabled for the employee's worker class.
postconditions_success: The requested information is shown or the request is submitted and visible in the employee's history.
Any request requiring approval is in the approver's unified inbox.
postconditions_failure: Nothing is submitted; the employee sees why and can retry, or the action is queued offline.

main_flow.action: Opens SCR-042 and unlocks it with the device's biometric or PIN.
Shows the home tiles for punch, payslip, leave, gate pass, tickets and announcements permitted to the employee.
Selects an action, for example 'My attendance'.
Shows the result, such as the day-by-day status on SCR-021 with net hours, late allowance left and the rule applied.
Raises a follow-up such as a regularisation for a specific day, filling only the fields the rule needs.
Validates and submits the request, confirms it on screen and routes it to the approver's unified inbox.

steps: Platform shows cached attendance for the last 60 days and cached payslips, labelled with the last sync time.
Write actions are queued and submitted on reconnection.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee asks for a payslip.
steps: Platform shows the latest payslip with a run selector where the period has more than one run.

exception_flows.condition: A queued offline request conflicts with a change made meanwhile (for example the day was already regularised).
exception_flows.handling: The queued request is rejected on sync and the employee is told why.

exception_flows.condition: The employee selects an action outside their permissions.
exception_flows.handling: The tile is not shown; a deep link to it returns 'not available for your role'.

nfrs: Home loads within 2 seconds at p95 on a mid-range phone over 4G.
Any listed action is reachable in three taps or fewer from home.
Offline cache is encrypted on the device.

user_stories.want: to see which rule marked my day as a half day
user_stories.so_that: I understand my attendance without raising a ticket

acceptance.given: E1019 was marked half day on 2026-09-10 for a fourth late arrival beyond the 15-minute grace
acceptance.when: she opens My attendance for 10 September
acceptance.then: the day shows half day with the rule and the three earlier late days listed

acceptance.given: the half day is shown
acceptance.then: a request form opens pre-filled with the date and needs only a reason

user_stories.want: to read my attendance and payslip with no network
user_stories.so_that: I can check them on the shop floor where signal is poor

acceptance.given: my phone is offline and last synced at 07:42
acceptance.then: the last 60 days are shown with 'last synced 07:42'

acceptance.given: I submit a leave request offline
acceptance.then: the request is submitted and appears in my history

use_cases.name: Act on pending approvals from one unified inbox
use_cases.goal: Give each approver one queue for every pending item across modules, actionable in place on any channel with the rule context needed to decide.

stakeholders.interest: Requests are decided quickly and with reasons.

use_cases.trigger: Any item awaits the approver's decision.
preconditions: The approver is authenticated and holds a reporting line or role that routes items to them.
postconditions_success: The approval step is decided with decision, reason where required, and channel recorded; platform.approval.step_decided is emitted.
postconditions_failure: The item stays pending with its SLA running and remains in the queue.

main_flow.action: Aggregates every pending item for the approver across leave, gate pass, overtime, regularisation, loan, requisition, letters and claims into one queue.
Approves or rejects in place from the notification or the queue, on web, mobile or the business messaging channel.
Shows with each item the rule context that bears on the decision, such as late allowance left, gate-pass hours left or leave expiring.

steps: Approver selects a delegate within scope and a validity period.
The item moves to the delegate's queue with the delegation recorded.
The decision is queued on the device.
On reconnection it is submitted with the original decision time.

exception_flows.condition: The item was already decided on another channel.
exception_flows.handling: The second action is not applied; the approver sees the current decision and who made it.

exception_flows.condition: A rejection is submitted without a reason.
exception_flows.handling: The rejection is refused until a reason is entered.

exception_flows.condition: The context source is unavailable.
exception_flows.handling: The item shows that context could not be loaded rather than hiding the gap.

exception_flows.condition: The approver is also the requester.
exception_flows.handling: The item is routed to the next approver and never appears in the requester's own queue.

nfrs: Queue loads 200 items within 2 seconds at p95.
A decision made on any channel is reflected on all others within 5 seconds.

user_stories.want: all my pending items across modules in one queue
user_stories.so_that: I do not check a separate inbox per module

acceptance.given: I have 3 leave requests, 2 gate passes, 1 overtime request and 1 expense claim pending
acceptance.then: all 7 items appear in one list sorted by SLA due

acceptance.given: a new regularisation request arrives
acceptance.then: it appears in the same list

user_stories.want: to see the rule context with each request
user_stories.so_that: I avoid approving something that causes a surprise deduction

acceptance.given: Kavya Venkatesh requests a third gate pass with 4 hours and 2 instances used in September
acceptance.then: the item shows 0 hours and 0 instances remaining

acceptance.given: a leave request is for a day with 3 earned leave days expiring on 2026-12-31
acceptance.then: the expiring balance is shown

user_stories.want: to approve directly from the business messaging channel
user_stories.so_that: I can decide while away from my desk

acceptance.given: a leave request notification arrives on the business messaging channel
acceptance.then: the leave is approved and the channel is recorded as the decision source

acceptance.given: I already rejected the same request on web
acceptance.when: I reply Approve on the messaging channel
acceptance.then: the approval is not applied and I am told it was rejected on web

use_cases.name: Transact through the business messaging channel
use_cases.goal: Let employees apply, approve, check in and fetch payslips through the business messaging channel as a first-class channel with the same rules as the app.

stakeholders.interest: Workers without the app still reach self-service.
Identity is verified before any data is shared.

use_cases.trigger: A message arrives from an employee's registered mobile number.
preconditions: The employee's mobile number is registered and verified.
The tenant's business messaging account is active.
postconditions_success: The requested information is returned or the transaction completes through the same domain services as the app, with an audit entry.
postconditions_failure: No data is shared and no write happens; the employee is told why.

main_flow.action: Delivers the employee's message to the integration service.
Matches the number to a principal and verifies the session by one-time code if none is active.
Interprets the intent, such as apply leave, check in, fetch payslip or approve an item.
For a write, replies with a summary and asks for explicit confirmation.
Confirms the action.
Executes it through the same domain service as the app and replies with the outcome and reference.
Records the transaction in the audit trail with the channel as source.

alternate_flows.condition: The intent is a read such as 'payslip September'.
steps: Platform returns the payslip as a password-protected document after verification.

alternate_flows.condition: The message is a reply to a lifecycle announcement.
steps: Platform records the reaction against the announcement.

exception_flows.condition: The number is not registered.
exception_flows.handling: No data is shared and the sender is told to contact HR.

exception_flows.condition: The employee does not confirm within 10 minutes.
exception_flows.handling: The pending action expires and nothing is written.

exception_flows.condition: The domain rule rejects the request (for example insufficient leave balance).
exception_flows.handling: The reason from the rule is returned in the reply.

nfrs: Replies are sent within 5 seconds at p95.
No personal data is sent before verification.

user_stories.want: to apply for leave by messaging
user_stories.so_that: I can do it without installing the app

acceptance.given: I am verified and have 6 casual leave days
acceptance.when: I send 'leave 15 Oct casual' and confirm
acceptance.then: a 1-day casual leave request is submitted and I receive its reference

acceptance.given: I do not confirm within 10 minutes
acceptance.then: no request is created

user_stories.want: my payslip only after my identity is verified
user_stories.so_that: no one else can get it by using my phone number

acceptance.given: my session has expired
acceptance.when: I ask for my September payslip
acceptance.then: I am asked for a one-time code before the payslip is sent

acceptance.given: a message comes from an unregistered number asking for E1019's payslip
acceptance.then: no data is returned

use_cases.name: Raise and resolve a helpdesk ticket
use_cases.goal: Route an employee question to the right resolver, resolve it within SLA using the employee's own record, and measure deflection.

stakeholders.interest: Workload by category and SLA performance are visible.
Answers grounded in their own data.

use_cases.trigger: An employee has a question or issue the assistant could not resolve, or chooses to raise a ticket.
preconditions: Categories, routing rules and SLAs by priority are configured per location.
postconditions_success: The ticket is resolved with a resolution note referencing the employee's records and confirmed or auto-closed.
postconditions_failure: The ticket is escalated and remains open with the breach recorded.

main_flow.action: Raises a ticket on SCR-041 choosing a category and describing the issue.
Routes it to the resolver group for the category and location and sets the SLA from priority.
Investigates using the employee's records and records a resolution with the evidence shown.
Notifies the employee and asks for confirmation.
Confirms resolution or reopens the ticket with a reason.
Closes the ticket and records whether it could have been deflected by the assistant.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee does not respond within 3 working days.
The issue needs a manager's input.
steps: Resolver assigns a sub-task to the manager and the SLA pauses while awaiting employee or manager input.

exception_flows.condition: The SLA is breached.
exception_flows.handling: The ticket escalates to the resolver group lead and is flagged on the dashboard.

exception_flows.condition: The ticket concerns harassment.
exception_flows.handling: The employee is directed to the confidential case channel and the ticket holds no details.

nfrs: Resolvers see only the records within their own data scope.

user_stories.want: my ticket answered with evidence from my own record
user_stories.so_that: I understand the outcome instead of just being told it is correct

acceptance.given: Rahul Gaikwad raises 'comp-off credit from 31 May has disappeared'
acceptance.then: the resolution shows the credit lapsed on 30 July, 60 days after crediting, with the ledger movement

acceptance.given: I reopen the ticket with a reason
acceptance.then: the ticket returns to the resolver with its SLA restarted

user_stories.want: tickets routed by category and location with SLA timers
user_stories.so_that: each query reaches the right person and nothing is forgotten

acceptance.given: a High priority payroll ticket is raised on 2026-09-09
acceptance.then: it is assigned to the payroll resolver group with SLA due 2026-09-10

acceptance.given: the SLA passes unresolved
acceptance.then: the ticket escalates to the group lead

use_cases.name: Answer a policy question with grounded sources
use_cases.goal: Answer an employee's question only from retrieved policy and the employee's own data, execute simple actions on confirmation, and raise a ticket when unsure.

stakeholders.interest: Routine questions are answered correctly without a ticket.
No answer is invented and no write happens without consent.

use_cases.trigger: An employee asks a question on any supported channel.
preconditions: Policy documents are published and indexed.
The agent principal is scoped narrower than the asking employee.
postconditions_success: The employee receives a cited answer, or a confirmed action is executed and logged in the action ledger.
postconditions_failure: A ticket is created and the employee is told so; no guessed answer is given.

main_flow.action: Asks a question in the app, on the web, on the business messaging channel or in the collaboration workspace.
Retrieves policy clauses and the employee's own data under the employee's own permissions.
Answers with citations, or performs a simple action such as applying leave after the employee confirms it.
Checks that a confident, grounded answer exists before closing the conversation.

alternate_flows.condition: The request is a write (apply leave, request gate pass).
steps: Agent shows a dry-run summary of the change.
Employee confirms; agent executes and logs the action in the action ledger.

alternate_flows.condition: No confident, grounded answer is available.
steps: Agent creates a ticket with the question and retrieved context.
Agent tells the employee a ticket was raised and gives its number.

exception_flows.condition: The question asks about another person's data.
exception_flows.handling: Retrieval is limited to the asker's permissions and the agent says it cannot share that data.

exception_flows.condition: No source is retrieved.
exception_flows.handling: No answer is generated; the flow moves to ticket creation.

exception_flows.condition: The employee declines the confirmation.
exception_flows.handling: Nothing is written and the cancellation is logged.

exception_flows.condition: The agent's confidence is below threshold.
exception_flows.handling: A ticket is created and the employee is told so.

nfrs: First answer token within 3 seconds at p95.
Every answer shows at least one citation that opens the source clause.

user_stories.want: answers that cite the policy clause they come from
user_stories.so_that: I can trust and check the answer

acceptance.given: the leave policy says casual leave cannot be carried forward
acceptance.when: I ask 'can I carry forward casual leave?'
acceptance.then: the answer says no and links to that clause

acceptance.given: no indexed policy covers sabbaticals
acceptance.then: no answer is given, a ticket is raised and I receive its number

user_stories.want: the assistant to act only after I confirm
user_stories.so_that: nothing changes on my record without my consent

acceptance.given: I ask the assistant to apply 1 day casual leave on 2026-10-15
acceptance.then: no request exists until I confirm

acceptance.given: I confirm
acceptance.then: the leave request is created and the action ledger records tool, inputs and my confirmation

user_stories.want: the assistant never to reveal another employee's data
user_stories.so_that: privacy is preserved even for curious questions

acceptance.given: E1019 asks 'what is Rahul's leave balance?'
acceptance.then: no data about Rahul is returned and the answer says it cannot share it

acceptance.given: the same question is asked by Rahul's manager
acceptance.then: the balance is returned because it is within the manager's scope

use_cases.name: Publish and find answers in the HR service catalogue and knowledge base
use_cases.goal: Provide a searchable catalogue of HR services and a versioned, owned, multilingual knowledge base.

stakeholders.interest: Find the right service or article in their language.
Grounds answers in current articles only.

use_cases.trigger: HR publishes or updates an article or service, or an employee searches.
preconditions: Article owners and review cycles are configured.
postconditions_success: The article is published with owner, version, review date and language variants and is searchable and citable.
postconditions_failure: The article stays in draft or is withdrawn from search and grounding.

main_flow.action: Drafts an article or catalogue entry with owner, audience, review date and linked service form.
Adds language variants, each marked with its translator and status.
Submits for review; the reviewer approves and the platform publishes a new version.
Indexes the version for search and assistant grounding and retires the prior version from grounding.
Searches the catalogue in their language and opens the article or service.
Reminds the owner 14 days before the review date.

alternate_flows.condition: No variant exists in the employee's language.
steps: Platform shows the English version with a note that a translation is not available.

exception_flows.condition: The review date passes without review.
exception_flows.handling: The article is flagged stale and excluded from assistant grounding until reviewed.

nfrs: Search returns results within 1 second at p95.

user_stories.want: articles to expire from assistant grounding when their review date passes
user_stories.so_that: the assistant never cites stale policy

acceptance.given: an article's review date is 2026-10-01
acceptance.then: it is flagged stale and excluded from grounding

acceptance.given: I review and republish it
acceptance.then: the assistant cites the new version

user_stories.want: to search HR articles in Marathi
user_stories.so_that: I can understand policy in my own language

acceptance.given: the gate pass article has a published Marathi variant
acceptance.then: the Marathi article is returned

acceptance.given: the overtime article has no Marathi variant
acceptance.then: the English version is shown with a note that a translation is not available

use_cases.name: Compose and run a guided employee journey
use_cases.goal: Let HR compose journeys of tasks, content and nudges for life events and deliver them to the right employees at the right time.

stakeholders.interest: Clear guidance at key life moments.
Knows what the employee needs from them.

use_cases.trigger: A life event occurs (for example maternity leave approved, relocation, first-time manager promotion).
preconditions: A journey template is published with trigger, steps and audience.
postconditions_success: The employee completes or is guided through all journey steps; completion is tracked.
postconditions_failure: The journey is paused or cancelled with reason.

main_flow.action: Composes a journey with trigger, ordered tasks, content items and nudges with timing.
Publishes the journey for a target audience.
Starts the journey for an employee when the trigger event occurs.
Delivers each task and nudge at its scheduled time on the employee's preferred channel.
Completes tasks; the platform records progress.
Completes manager tasks within the journey, such as a return-to-work conversation.
Closes the journey and asks the employee for feedback.

alternate_flows.condition: The trigger is reversed (for example leave cancelled).
steps: Platform cancels the journey and withdraws pending nudges.

exception_flows.condition: A task links to a retired form or article.
exception_flows.handling: The step is skipped and HR is alerted to fix the journey.

nfrs: Journey steps respect the employee's quiet hours for nudges.

user_stories.want: to build a new-parent journey once and have it start automatically
user_stories.so_that: every new parent gets the same support

acceptance.given: a new-parent journey triggers on maternity leave approval
acceptance.when: an employee's maternity leave from 2026-11-01 is approved
acceptance.then: the journey starts with the benefits checklist task

acceptance.given: the leave is cancelled
acceptance.then: the journey is cancelled and pending nudges withdrawn

user_stories.want: to see my tasks within a team member's journey
user_stories.so_that: I play my part at the right moment

acceptance.given: a return-to-work task is due on 2027-05-02
acceptance.then: the task appears in my unified inbox

acceptance.given: I complete it
acceptance.then: the step shows Complete with my name

use_cases.name: Use self-service with assistive technology
use_cases.goal: Ensure every self-service surface conforms to WCAG 2.2 AA and works with screen readers, keyboard-only use and high-contrast themes.

stakeholders.interest: Equal access to all self-service actions.

use_cases.trigger: An employee using assistive technology opens a self-service screen.
preconditions: Screens have passed automated and manual accessibility checks before release.
postconditions_success: The employee completes the action using only assistive technology.
postconditions_failure: A defect is logged against the screen with the failed success criterion.

main_flow.action: Opens SCR-042 with a screen reader active.
Announces the page title, landmarks and the tile names in a logical order.
Moves through the leave form using only the keyboard.
Shows a visible focus indicator and keeps focus order matching the visual order.
Submits the form with a missing field.
Announces the error, moves focus to the first invalid field and describes how to fix it.
Corrects the field and submits successfully; the confirmation is announced.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee selects the high-contrast theme.
steps: Platform applies the theme across all screens with a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for text.

exception_flows.condition: A control is not reachable by keyboard.
exception_flows.handling: Treated as a release-blocking defect.

nfrs: Interactive targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

user_stories.want: to apply for leave using only a keyboard and screen reader
user_stories.so_that: I can use self-service independently

acceptance.given: a screen reader is active
acceptance.when: I tab through the leave form
acceptance.then: every field announces its label and required state

acceptance.given: I submit with the end date empty
acceptance.then: the error is announced and focus moves to the end date field

user_stories.want: a high-contrast theme
user_stories.so_that: I can read screens in bright shop-floor light

acceptance.given: I select high contrast
acceptance.then: all text meets a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1

acceptance.given: I sign in on another device
acceptance.then: my theme choice is kept

use_cases.name: Use the native mobile app with offline access and biometric unlock
use_cases.goal: Give employees a native mobile app with biometric unlock and offline read of payslips, balances and documents.

stakeholders.interest: Lost or exited devices can be wiped.

use_cases.trigger: The employee installs and signs in to the app.
preconditions: The tenant has enabled mobile access and single sign-on via OIDC.
postconditions_success: The device is enrolled, biometric unlock is active and offline data is cached encrypted.
postconditions_failure: The device is not enrolled and no data is cached.

main_flow.action: Installs the app and signs in through the tenant's identity provider.
Authenticates the employee and returns tokens to the app.
Enrols the device and offers biometric unlock.
Enables biometric unlock.
Syncs payslips for the last 12 months, leave balances and personal documents into an encrypted cache.
Opens a payslip while offline; the app shows it with the last sync time.

alternate_flows.condition: The device has no biometric hardware.
steps: The employee sets a 6-digit app PIN instead.

exception_flows.condition: The employee exits or the device is reported lost.
exception_flows.handling: Tenant admin revokes the device; the cache is wiped on next launch and tokens are invalidated.

exception_flows.condition: The device is rooted or jailbroken.
exception_flows.handling: Enrolment is refused and the reason is shown.

nfrs: Cold start under 3 seconds on a mid-range phone.
Offline cache encrypted with a device-bound key.

user_stories.want: to unlock the app with my fingerprint
user_stories.so_that: I get in quickly at the punch gate

acceptance.given: biometric unlock is enabled
acceptance.then: it unlocks after a fingerprint match without a password

acceptance.given: five failed fingerprint attempts occur
acceptance.then: the app asks for my PIN

user_stories.want: to revoke a lost device
user_stories.so_that: cached payslips cannot be read by whoever finds it

acceptance.given: E1023 reports her phone lost on 2026-10-03
acceptance.then: the tokens are invalidated immediately

acceptance.given: the lost phone is opened later
acceptance.then: the cache is wiped and sign-in is required
